literal: Not letting (the mind) go in the path it went, avoiding evil, and directing it towards goodness is wisdom.
translation: Wisdom consists in not letting the mind wander wherever it desires, but restraining it from evil and directing it towards the path of goodness.
modern: மனம் போன போக்கிலே அதைச் செல்ல விடாமல், தீமையிலிருந்து விலக்கி, நன்மையான வழியில் செலுத்துவதே அறிவாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines true wisdom as the active discipline and control of the mind. The mind naturally tends to wander in the direction of sensory desires and impulses. Wisdom does not allow the mind to run free in these directions, but instead restrains it from harmful paths and steers it toward what is good and virtuous. Thus, wisdom is not merely intellectual capacity, but the practical mastery of one's thoughts and actions.
